hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: The count of subarrays with exactly k distinct elements equals the count with at most k distinct elements minus the count with at most k minus one distinct elements.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Maintain frequency counts inside an expandable window and advance the left pointer when unique values exceed the threshold.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Accumulate the number of valid subarrays ending at each right pointer position.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pass dynamic window computes exact k distinct subarrays.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) subarrays takes quadratic time.
